summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting its April 2026 traffic statistics. The filing provides routine operational data, showing monthly guests grew 5% year-over-year to 19.3 million and a load factor of 93%, with rolling twelve-month guests up 4% to 209.3 million. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, structural mechanics, or regulatory clocks involved. The filing is a standard monthly operational update from a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event is present.
